title: After Sales Services – Data Analysis & Operations Support Intern
desc:
Who we are?
Wilo is proud to be one of the leading companies in the pump industry and a premium supplier for building technology, water management and the industrial sector. By developing excellent products and solutions, we not only move water, but also the future for people all over the world.
Major movements like globalization, digitalization and energy shortages shape some of our largest future challenges. Challenges that we are happy to accept and dive into. We understand the trends that influence our company and our business and act accordingly. By developing products and solutions we move not only water, but we also move the future for people all over the world. As a pioneer in the pump industry, we focus as much on our employees as on our high-quality pumps. Those of you who want to be part of the Wilo will experience a constant flow of personal and organizational development as well as sufficient space for the implementation of own ideas.
At Wilo you will move the future, for yourself and for others.
We are looking for a After Sales Services – Data Analysis & Operations Support Intern to join our organization in Turkey.
Job Requirements
Preferably an undergraduate student in Industrial Engineering, Management Information Systems, Computer Engineering, Statistics, or a related field.
Good command of Excel.
Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, file tracking, and basic reporting skills.
English proficiency to understand and work with English data templates.
Familiarity with Power Query is preferred; basic knowledge of CRM/database concepts or tools such as Power BI, SQL, and Python is a plus.
Job Responsibilities
Consolidate, organize, and prepare data from different sources for analysis and reporting.
Support weekly and monthly reporting on open service cases, completed activities, and operational KPIs.
Assist in standardizing recurring data processing and reporting activities.
Prepare and update tracking files for service partners and maintenance contracts, including inventory, dates, status, and missing documentation.
Support the organization and maintenance of service partner and operational records.
Assist the team with assigned and authorized standard data entry, documentation, and tracking activities.
